pages.text: Frieren's destructive lightning: purple bolts that run wild around the target area while the caster is unharmed. Three levels increase damage and radius. Damage: 2.2× spell power to everything within 1.5 + level blocks.

pages.title: At a glance
pages.text: $(l)School:$() Lightning$(br)$(l)Rarity:$() Epic and up$(br)$(l)Levels:$() 3$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 130 (+10 per level)$(br)$(l)Cooldown:$() 18 s$(br)$(l)Cast:$() Long, 1.5 s$(br)$(l)Effect:$() 2.2x spell power within 1.5 + level blocks$(br)$(o)Before gear bonuses: 17.6 at level 1, 30.8 at level 3.$()
